summary: Returns the usable size of a memory allocation, selecting strategy by OS version code dword_8D4908. Version 3 reads the region header via sub_593E1B and computes *(lpMem - 1) - 9. Version 2 resolves the pool block index via MemoryRegionValidationHeapLookup and computes 16 * *v3. Both paths run under critical section 9 and fall back to HeapSize(hHeap, 0, lpMem) when the lookup failed or the version is neither 2 nor 3. Called by sub_587AC0.

local_names.lpMem: allocation pointer whose usable size is queried
local_names.v3: pool block index byte returned by MemoryRegionValidationHeapLookup (OS v2 path)
local_names.v6: alias of v3 used to test lookup success
local_names.v8: prior computed size retained across the SEH frame (uninitialized artifact)
local_names.v9: result of sub_593E1B region lookup (OS v3 path)
local_names.v5: out buffer for the region validation lookup
local_names.v7: out buffer for the region validation lookup
local_names.v2: flag set when the active lookup failed, gating the HeapSize fallback

operations.description: OS version guard: when dword_8D4908 == 3 the region-header size path (critical section + sub_593E1B lookup) is taken; otherwise the code checks the OS version 2 path or falls back
When dword_8D4908 is neither 3 nor 2 the function returns HeapSize(hHeap, 0, lpMem) immediately (default heap-size query)
CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter(9) enters critical section 9 for thread safety
sub_593E1B(lpMem) looks up region metadata for the allocation (OS v3 path)
On successful region lookup, v1 = *(lpMem - 1) - 9 computes the usable block size from the allocation header dword immediately preceding the pointer
MemoryRegionValidationHeapLookup(lpMem, v5, v7) resolves the pool block index for the allocation (OS v2 pool path)
v1 = 16 * *v3 scales the pool block index byte by a stride of 16 to obtain the block size
HeapSize(hHeap, 0, lpMem) queries the private heap for the block size as the fallback when the active lookup failed
Return the computed size v1 when the lookup succeeded, or the HeapSize(hHeap, 0, lpMem) fallback when the lookup failed

The relationships '*(lpMem - 1) - 9' and '16 * *v3' are inferred as block-size computations; the exact allocation-header and pool layout are unknown
The fallback through the uninitialized v8 when a lookup returns zero is a decompiler artifact and its effective value is not trustworthy
